meta.title: Add HTTP benchmark implementation
meta.body_summary: Add benchmarking tools (Python and shell scripts) to compare performance of Python (FastAPI) and Rust implementations of RequestRepo backend, including metrics like requests/sec and latency.

perf_labels.notes: Devin added a massive Rust backend implementation plus benchmarking scripts; merged by maintainer with no human review or performance evidence.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 5744 added lines (0 deletions), this is a large-scale addition by absolute volume. As a performance benchmarking infrastructure PR, it was merged directly without review, likely due to maintainer trust or automated approval.

review_details.performance_claim: PR adds benchmarking tools to compare Python and Rust backends but does not provide actual performance data.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: A large-scale infrastructure addition including a full Rust rewrite was merged with no human review, suggesting an automated or trust-based merge process.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: Benchmark scripts and usage instructions are provided, but no performance results or execution logs are included to verify claimed comparisons.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: No regressions occurred; the PR was merged without feedback.

core_change_summary.description: Added a complete Rust backend implementation (HTTP, DNS, cache, etc.) under src/ and a Python benchmark suite (benchmark.py, run_benchmark.sh, README) under benchmarks/ to compare Python and Rust performance.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Extensive Rust library and test files added; Cargo.lock accounts for the largest single file change (2390 lines).
change_trajectory: First commit (98223b5): complete Rust backend rewrite (5203 lines) with modules for HTTP, DNS, SMTP, cache, etc.
Second commit (de73f9c): benchmark scripts and documentation (541 lines).
